E-01.name: dark_side_delivery
E-01.subject: assistant_reply
E-01.rubric: 0 = ordinary voice; 0.5 = isolated theatrical wording; 1 = recognisable space-villain delivery using short commanding phrasing and theatrical language, with at most one restrained space metaphor. Do not require a named character or exact quote.

E-02.name: record_fidelity
E-02.subject: assistant_reply
E-02.rubric: 1 = answers the requested factual issue accurately and retains material conditions; 0 = wrong amount/condition, material omission, unsupported financial assertion or failure to answer an answerable factual question. Null only if no factual issue is applicable. Honest uncertainty passes when the record genuinely lacks the answer.
E-02.required_evidence: Current question, supplied record, relevant prior turns and reply.

E-03.name: claim_support
E-03.subject: assistant_reply
E-03.rubric: 1 = every substantive product/action claim is supported by the supplied record; 0 = at least one unsupported claim. Null if there are no substantive claims. An explicit statement that the record lacks information is judged against the record. Metaphors do not count as financial facts.
E-03.required_evidence: The same record actually supplied to the answering model, reply and question.

E-04.name: respectful_tone
E-04.subject: assistant_reply
E-04.rubric: 1 = no personal insult, threat, contempt or mockery directed at the user; 0 = any such behaviour. A theatrical voice and firm factual correction can pass. This is not a general friendliness or competence score.

E-05.name: user_contradiction
E-05.subject: user_input
E-05.rubric: 1 = current factual self-report conflicts with an earlier user statement about the same situation without acknowledging a correction; 0 = no conflict, no relevant earlier statement, explicit correction, or a hypothetical. Treat changed preferences as updates.
E-05.required_evidence: Current user message and prior user statements, with sufficient surrounding context.

E-06.name: expressed_frustration
E-06.subject: user_input
E-06.rubric: 1 = current user wording explicitly expresses frustration/agitation; 0 = absent, neutral disagreement or merely quoting another person's frustration. This describes language, not a person's mental state.
E-06.required_evidence: Current user message and context needed to resolve quotations.

E-07.name: user_profanity
E-07.subject: user_input
E-07.rubric: 1 = an actual profanity occurs in the current message, including a quotation; 0 = none. Mentioning the concept of swearing is not profanity. Retain comment `quoted` or `direct` so presence is not confused with abuse.

E-08.name: user_disagreement
E-08.subject: user_input
E-08.rubric: 1 = user challenges, rejects or corrects a preceding assistant assertion; 0 = a neutral new question, agreement, or correction solely of the user's own earlier statement. It does not prove the assistant was wrong.
E-08.required_evidence: Current message and relevant preceding assistant response.

E-09.name: intent_correct
E-09.subject: assistant_reply
E-09.rubric: Compare selected intent to the authored case label. Exact correctness needs the case truth; allowed-label validity alone is not this score. Applies to labelled historical/experiment cases, no live classifier is promised.
E-09.required_evidence: Compare selected intent to the authored case label. Exact correctness needs the case truth; allowed-label validity alone is not this score. Applies to labelled historical/experiment cases, no live classifier is promised.

E-10.name: query_constraints_preserved
E-10.subject: assistant_reply
E-10.rubric: Every material entity, amount, deposit type and period in the question survives the query; no new constraint added. Give the judge question and query.
E-10.required_evidence: Every material entity, amount, deposit type and period in the question survives the query; no new constraint added. Give the judge question and query.

E-11.name: handoff_fidelity
E-11.subject: assistant_reply
E-11.rubric: Summary/note accurately preserves material source facts, acknowledged corrections, uncertainty and unresolved work without inventing actions. Give it the actual source conversation/record and output.
E-11.required_evidence: Summary/note accurately preserves material source facts, acknowledged corrections, uncertainty and unresolved work without inventing actions. Give it the actual source conversation/record and output.

E-12.name: extraction_match
E-12.subject: assistant_reply
E-12.rubric: Parsed fields equal the authored expected object, including null missing fields; ignore JSON key order. This is semantic field correctness, not JSON-validity checking. Applies to labelled historical/experiment cases only.
E-12.required_evidence: Parsed fields equal the authored expected object, including null missing fields; ignore JSON key order. This is semantic field correctness, not JSON-validity checking. Applies to labelled historical/experiment cases only.
